_comment: What the Android app ships under www/assets/: the world map, trimmed to the z8 the map actually renders (scripts/trim-pmtiles.mjs), plus the web-sized regions GeoJSON and the editor seeds. Every file is a release asset of the map-data GitHub Release, pinned by size and sha256; mobile/scripts/stage-map-assets.mjs downloads and verifies them into mobile/map-cache/ and stage-www.mjs copies them into the bundle. The 55 MB desktop-only files are never shipped.
